text: dsh-safe-web-fetch 为 DSH 的 ctx.web 注册 safe-http 获取服务，并通过 bundle 将其设为 web_fetch 使用的 fetch provider，同时保留搜索 provider。它可请求 HTTP(S) 页面、按响应类型返回 HTML 或文本，并提供主机匹配配置、同源重定向处理及请求和响应大小限制。适合希望在 DSH 的网页获取流程中使用可配置 HTTP 获取实现的用户。无需 API 密钥；获取内容来自用户请求的网址。

dsh-safe-web-fetch adds an HTTP(S) provider to DSH web_fetch. Its bundle selects this provider while retaining the search provider. It returns HTML or text and offers host options, redirect handling, and response limits. No API key is configured; fetched content comes from the requested URL.
我想让 DSH 的网页获取工具使用可配置的 HTTP fetch provider。
能不能把网页请求结果作为 HTML 或普通文本交给 DSH？
我需要限制网页获取的响应大小、字符数和等待时间。
想配置网页获取允许或拒绝访问的主机名单。
I need DSH to fetch a web page and return its content as HTML or text.
How can I configure the HTTP fetch provider used by DSH web_fetch?
dsh-safe-web-fetch 的功能「DSH 网页获取」：向 ctx.web 注册 safe-http provider，供 web_fetch 请求网址并返回 DSH 网页结果。
dsh-safe-web-fetch 的功能「响应读取」：按响应类型返回 HTML 或文本，可限制响应字节数、字符数，并标记内容截断。
dsh-safe-web-fetch 的功能「主机与跳转选项」：用户可设置 allowHosts 和 denyHosts；插件处理 HTTP(S) 地址及同源跳转，并提供跳转次数与请求超时配置。
dsh-safe-web-fetch 使用前须知：网页获取会向每次请求提供的网址发出 HTTP GET，并把响应内容作为结果返回；没有配置 API 密钥。

dsh-safe-web-fetch README · dsh-safe-web-fetch：`dsh-safe-web-fetch` gives [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) a safer way to use its `web_fetch` capability. It plugs into DSH's existing `ctx.web` service, so it works with the normal tool and profile system instead of introducing a second web-search API.

dsh-safe-web-fetch README · dsh-safe-web-fetch：The idea is simple: a hostname must resolve to a public address before a connection is opened. Each request hop is pinned to the addresses that were checked, redirects stay on the same origin, and responses are kept within predictable size and time limits.

dsh-safe-web-fetch README · Quick start：The package includes a DSH bundle, so one command installs it and adds the profile layer:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile safe add dsh-safe-web-fetch@next
dsh --profile safe --dump-config
```

The bundle registers a `safe-http` provider, enables DSH's existing `web_fetch` tool, and leaves search on the base profile's provider. For a deployment, pin the version you have tested:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile production add dsh-safe-web-fetch@0.1.0-next.0
```

dsh-safe-web-fetch README · Quick start：You can install a reviewed Git revision instead:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile safe add github:MostlyHarmlessxyz/dsh-safe-web-fetch#<commit-sha>
```

Git installs build the package locally. If pnpm asks you to approve that build, follow the profile-specific instruction it prints; an npm package or tarball is the simpler option when you want prebuilt files.

dsh-safe-web-fetch README · What it does：It does not add cookies, authorization headers, browser state, or request bodies. A public address is not automatically trustworthy content: prompt injection, malware, and HTML sanitization remain application concerns.

dsh-safe-web-fetch README · Configuration：The defaults are deliberately modest:

| Option | Default | Maximum |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| `maxUrlLength` | `2048` | `16384` |
| `maxResponseBytes` | `5000000` | `100000000` |
| `maxBodyChars` | `100000` | `10000000` |
| `timeoutMs` | `30000` | Node timer limit |
| `maxRedirects` | `5` | `20` |
| `maxConcurrentRequests` | `16` | `128` |

dsh-safe-web-fetch README · Configuration：`allowHosts`, `denyHosts`, and `userAgent` are also configurable. DSH replaces a row's complete config when a patch targets it, so include every value you want to keep:

```yaml
- id: safe-web-fetch
  name: dsh-safe-web-fetch
  config:
    maxUrlLength: 4096

dsh-safe-web-fetch README · Configuration：If you mount the function plugin yourself instead of using the bundle, set `fetchProvider: safe-http` on the `web` row. When more than one provider is available, always select one by id; DSH will otherwise report `WEB_PROVIDER_AMBIGUOUS` rather than guessing.

dsh-safe-web-fetch README · A note about the security boundary：The built-in resolver is raced against the request deadline, but a third-party resolver cannot always be stopped at the operating-system level. A custom resolver or transport is an extension point for tests and trusted integrations, not a way to make an untrusted network client safe.
section: A note about the security boundary

text: dsh-safe-web-fetch README · A note about the security boundary：This package deliberately follows only same-origin redirects and handles text responses. It is not an egress firewall, content scanner, approval screen, or proxy policy. For an organization-wide zero-trust network, keep those controls at the network boundary and use this provider as an additional check.
section: A note about the security boundary

dsh-safe-web-fetch README · Compatibility and development：The published peer range covers DSH `0.1.0-rc.5` through the `0.1.x` line and Cordis `4.x`. DSH is still a developer preview, so test the exact versions used by your profile.

Requires Node `^22.19.0` or `>=24.0.0` and pnpm 11:

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm run build

dsh-safe-web-fetch README · Compatibility and development：The tests include address-range and malformed-DNS cases, redirect revalidation, cancellation, response limits, lifecycle disposal, and a local HTTP server that verifies the socket is pinned while the original `Host` header is retained.
